summary: This clinical study looks at how study medicines like CagriSema, cagrilintide, and semaglutide affect muscle health in people with excess body weight as they lose weight. The sponsor for this trial is Novo Nordisk A/S, and it is currently in Phase 1. The study aims to enroll 100 participants who are between 50 and 70 years old. The status of this trial is Recruiting.
